title: College Football Week Ahead
subject: CFB Week 3: Houston–Texas Tech leads 10 games worth researching
preview_text: Widest gap to a book number: 5.6 points on Tulane at Kansas State. 9 of 10 featured games carry a book number. Research, not picks.

paragraphs: EdgeDesk scored 75 upcoming college football games for Week 3 and put 10 in front of you.
The widest disagreement with a book number is 5.6 points. 9 of the 10 featured games carry a joined sportsbook number; the rest are model-only reads.

6 games with a larger gap were left out on purpose: the discrepancy was bigger than the evidence behind it. A big number on thin data is the most common way research goes wrong, and leaving it out is the finding.

difference.text: Both numbers above are quoted from Texas Tech’s side, and EdgeDesk’s sits 4.8 points toward Texas Tech of the market’s.

why.text: On EdgeDesk’s own ETSR (overall) scale it has Texas Tech #10 of 68 at +7.0 and Houston #37 of 68 at +1.4.

why.source: matchups.Texas Tech run offense vs Houston run defense
why.text: Texas Tech’s run offense rates 45.8 (#49 of 68) against Houston’s run defense at 60.3 (#10 of 68). Houston’s unit stands higher among its own position group, by 39 places.
Texas Tech carries the wider measured edge on Scheme fit — 53.5 · #3 of 68 against Houston’s 49.1 · #54 of 68.
